bounded_conclusion: Within the inspected corpus, no source contains the combination of compulsory optimality for a protected prefix face, a moving best retaining continuation, a floor-truncated weighted simultaneous demand ball, exact fixed-path and bracket certificates, and nearest-boundary semantics. The full-path case and generic stability radii are not claimed as novel. The closest omitted comparators—interval-demand minimax-regret lot sizing and inverse lot-sizing cost elicitation—have materially different quantifiers and targets.
missingness: Search was targeted rather than systematic.
